description: Translate the templates/ directory and the .kiro/rules/ steering files. The templates ship to downstream OMK projects via tools/init-project.sh, so they're user-facing, but tests/test-agents-template.sh asserts on specific English phrases inside templates/agents-sections/*.md and tests/test-init-project.sh asserts on 'Coding agent' and 'GTM' inside templates/agents-types/*.md. Those literals MUST be preserved. The .kiro/rules/ files are largely Chinese with English headings; translate the English passages and headings only.
steps: For templates/agents-sections/principles.md: file body is mostly Chinese; the only English content is the principle names (e.g. 'Evidence before claims', 'As code', 'TDD driven', etc.) used as bullet labels. Per FEAT-001's translation-rules.md these are consecrated principle names and must remain in English (also asserted by test-agents-template.sh which greps for 'Evidence before claims'). The Chinese parentheticals stay Chinese. The HTML comment markers `<!-- BEGIN OMK PRINCIPLES -->` and `<!-- END OMK PRINCIPLES -->` are asserted by the test and must stay verbatim. The only translatable token in this file is the heading `## Principles` which can become `## Princípios` if and only if you also confirm no test or hook reads the heading text (run `grep -rn '## Principles' tests/ hooks/ scripts/` first; if any match exists, leave the heading in English). Default action: leave file UNCHANGED and record this in findings as 'no English prose to translate'.

For templates/agents-sections/workflow.md: the test greps for the literal strings 'Explore' and 'Skill Routing'. Those phrases must remain. The body is mostly Chinese. Apply the same logic as principles.md — confirm no English prose paragraphs exist that need translating. The heading `## Workflow` may stay (consecrated). The heading `## Skill Routing` MUST stay (asserted). The heading `## Knowledge Retrieval` may be translated to `## Recuperação de Conhecimento` only if no test depends on it. Default action: leave UNCHANGED and record in findings.

For templates/agents-sections/self-learning.md: tiny file, body in Chinese, only English token is `episodes.md` (path, must stay). Heading `## Self-Learning` may become `## Self-Learning` (consecrated) — leave unchanged. Default: UNCHANGED.
For templates/agents-sections/authority.md: heading `## Authority Matrix` is asserted by the test; must stay. `## Enforcement` is consecrated. Body is Chinese. Default: UNCHANGED.

For templates/agents-types/coding.md: this file has English prose ('Coding agent for this project. English unless user requests otherwise.', 'Backend / frontend / full-stack software engineer', 'Code reviewer and debugger', 'Architecture advisor', 'Write tests for all new logic', 'Follow existing code style and conventions', 'No hardcoded values — use constants or configuration'). PRESERVE the literal 'Coding agent' (asserted by test-init-project.sh:65). PRESERVE the literal 'OMK SECTIONS' inside the HTML comment. The single em dash on the 'No hardcoded values' line MUST be replaced with a hyphen or rephrased per the no-em-dash rule. Translate the rest of the prose to Portuguese. Example: 'Coding agent for this project. English unless user requests otherwise.' → 'Coding agent para este projeto. Inglês, salvo se o usuário solicitar outro idioma.' (keeps 'Coding agent' literal); 'Backend / frontend / full-stack software engineer' → 'Engenheiro(a) de software backend / frontend / full-stack'; 'Code reviewer and debugger' → 'Revisor(a) de código e debugger'; 'Architecture advisor' → 'Consultor(a) de arquitetura'; 'Write tests for all new logic' → 'Escreva testes para toda nova lógica'; 'Follow existing code style and conventions' → 'Siga o estilo e as convenções de código existentes'; 'No hardcoded values - use constants or configuration' (replace em dash with hyphen or 'Sem valores hard-coded; use constantes ou configuração').

For templates/agents-types/gtm.md: PRESERVE the literal 'GTM' (asserted by test-init-project.sh). Translate the prose: 'GTM (Google Tag Manager) agent for this project. English unless user requests otherwise.' → 'Agente GTM (Google Tag Manager) para este projeto. Inglês, salvo se o usuário solicitar outro idioma.' Translate the Roles bullets and Domain Rules bullets to Portuguese, preserving 'dataLayer', 'Preview mode', 'GTM container'.

For templates/knowledge/episodes.md and templates/knowledge/rules.md: short scaffolding files with English narrative comments at the top. Translate the narrative blockquotes and HTML comment instructions: '> Timestamped events. ≤30 entries. Auto-captured by hook + manual via @reflect.' → '> Eventos com timestamp. ≤30 entradas. Capturadas automaticamente pelo hook ou manualmente via @reflect.'; '> Auto-distilled from episodes. Injected by context-enrichment per message.' → '> Auto-destiladas a partir dos episodes. Injetadas pelo context-enrichment em cada mensagem.'; '> 🔴 = CRITICAL (always injected) | 🟡 = RELEVANT (keyword-matched)' → '> 🔴 = CRITICAL (sempre injetada) | 🟡 = RELEVANT (correspondência por palavra-chave)'; '> Sections auto-created by distill.sh. Max 5 rules per section.' → '> Seções criadas automaticamente por distill.sh. Máximo de 5 regras por seção.' Preserve `<!-- FORMAT: ... -->` and `<!-- STATUS: ... -->` HTML comments byte-identical (their content might be parsed by hooks).
For .kiro/rules/code-analysis.md: file is ENTIRELY Chinese. No English prose. SKIP unchanged. Record in findings.

For .kiro/rules/commands.md: mixed. The `## @lint — Health Check` heading uses an em dash which must be replaced with a hyphen. Translate the English narrative ('When user says `@lint`, run instruction health check:'), table headers ('Check / Question / If Yes →'), table cells (those cells are English questions like 'Code-enforceable: Can this be a linter/test/hook? → Write code, not prose'). Keep the bash code block verbatim. Keep the literal `@lint`, `@compact`, `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`. Keep the Chinese 'Language Matching' final block verbatim. Replace the em dash in `## @lint — Health Check` with a hyphen: `## @lint - Health Check` (or rephrase as `## @lint: Verificação de Saúde`).

For .kiro/rules/enforcement.md: English file. Translate the `> If it can be enforced by code, don't enforce it with words.` epigraph; translate section headings ('Hook Registry', 'Determinism Layers', 'Config Generation' → 'Registro de Hooks', 'Camadas de Determinismo', 'Geração de Configuração'). Translate every table cell. Preserve all hook script paths, event names (preToolUse[bash], postToolUse[write], etc.), exit codes, and code-block contents. Layer column values like '100% — unconditional hard block' have an em dash; replace with a hyphen: '100% - hard block incondicional'.

For .kiro/rules/reference.md: English file. Translate prose, headings, table cells. Preserve every fenced code block (Python, bash) verbatim, including comment lines inside the bash heredoc. Translate the Markdown comments preceding code blocks (`# ❌ Wrong: Long inline scripts` → `# ❌ Errado: scripts inline longos`).

Run grep verifications: `grep -c 'BEGIN OMK PRINCIPLES' templates/agents-sections/principles.md` >= 1; `grep -c 'Authority Matrix' templates/agents-sections/authority.md` >= 1; `grep -c 'Coding agent' templates/agents-types/coding.md` >= 1; `grep -c 'GTM' templates/agents-types/gtm.md` >= 1; `grep -c 'Skill Routing' templates/agents-sections/workflow.md` >= 1; `grep -c 'Evidence before claims' templates/agents-sections/principles.md` >= 1; `grep -c 'OMK SECTIONS' templates/agents-types/coding.md` >= 1.
Run `bash tests/test-agents-template.sh 2>&1 | tail -1` and confirm pass count is identical to baseline.

Commit: `git add templates/ .kiro/rules/ && git commit -m 'docs(i18n): translate templates and .kiro/rules to pt-BR; preserve test-anchored literals (Coding agent, GTM, OMK SECTIONS, BEGIN/END markers, Skill Routing, Authority Matrix, Evidence before claims)'`.
acceptance_criteria: templates/agents-types/coding.md has 'Coding agent' and 'OMK SECTIONS' literals AND has Portuguese prose elsewhere.
templates/agents-types/gtm.md has 'GTM' literal AND has Portuguese prose elsewhere.
All 4 templates/agents-sections/*.md still contain their BEGIN/END HTML markers and the test-asserted English phrases.
templates/knowledge/{episodes,rules}.md narrative blockquotes and HTML comments are preserved or translated correctly per the spec.
.kiro/rules/{commands,enforcement,reference}.md have Portuguese prose for the English passages, with em dashes replaced.
`bash tests/test-agents-template.sh` ends with the baseline pass/fail counts.
verification: grep -l 'Coding agent' templates/agents-types/coding.md && grep -l 'OMK SECTIONS' templates/agents-types/coding.md

for marker in 'BEGIN OMK PRINCIPLES' 'BEGIN OMK WORKFLOW' 'BEGIN OMK SELF-LEARNING' 'BEGIN OMK AUTHORITY' 'Evidence before claims' 'Skill Routing' 'Authority Matrix'; do grep -rl "$marker" templates/ || echo "MISSING: $marker"; done
